title.zh: 量子计算机到底能做什么 · 一篇从原理走到前沿的长文
title.en: What Quantum Computers Can Actually Do · From First Principles to the Frontier

desc.zh: 量子计算机到底能做什么普通计算机做不了的事？页面里有一台真的量子态模拟器：从一个量子比特、干涉、纠缠，到格罗弗搜索、肖尔分解、噪声和纠错，最后是标了日期和出处的 2026 年前沿。
desc.en: What can a quantum computer do that an ordinary one cannot? The page runs a real state-vector simulator: one qubit, interference, entanglement, Grover search, Shor factoring, noise and error correction, ending with a dated, sourced account of the 2026 frontier.

title.en: The qubit and the Born rule

desc.zh: 一个量子比特是布洛赫球面上的一点；测量只给 0 或 1，概率是振幅模的平方，换个测量方向结果就不同。
desc.en: A qubit is a point on the Bloch sphere; a measurement gives only 0 or 1, with probability the squared amplitude, and a different measurement axis gives different odds.

en: is a qubit 0 and 1 at once

desc.zh: 马赫–曾德尔干涉仪里，两条路的振幅一正一负就抵消；偷看走了哪条路，条纹就消失。
desc.en: In a Mach–Zehnder interferometer two paths with opposite amplitudes cancel; look at which path was taken and the fringes vanish.

desc.zh: 共享纠缠的两人赢 CHSH 游戏的概率是 85.4%，任何经典策略最多 75%；但纠缠不能传信。
desc.en: Two players sharing entanglement win the CHSH game 85.4% of the time against a classical ceiling of 75%, yet entanglement cannot send a message.

en: can entanglement send messages faster than light

desc.zh: n 个量子比特要 2ⁿ 个复数才能写下，经典模拟 50 个左右就存不下；但一次测量只能读出 n 个比特。
desc.en: n qubits need 2ⁿ complex numbers to write down, so classical simulation runs out of memory near 50; yet one measurement reads out only n bits.

zh: 量子模拟需要多少内存
量子计算机同时算所有答案吗
en: does a quantum computer try every answer at once

desc.zh: 问一次就分清函数是常数还是平衡：相位反冲加两层阿达马门，让答案落在全零上。
desc.en: One query tells a constant function from a balanced one: phase kickback between two Hadamard layers puts the answer on all-zeros.

desc.zh: 在 N 个里找一个，转约 (π/4)√N 轮；转多了概率反而下降。只是平方加速。
desc.en: Finding one item among N takes about (π/4)√N rounds, and turning further makes the odds fall again; the speed-up is only quadratic.

desc.zh: 用量子傅里叶变换找 aˣ mod N 的周期，再用连分数和最大公约数拆出因数；破 RSA-2048 需要的机器规模如何一路下降。
desc.en: The quantum Fourier transform finds the period of aˣ mod N, continued fractions and a gcd turn it into factors, and estimates of the machine needed for RSA-2048 keep falling.

zh: 量子计算机能破解密码吗
量子计算对比特币的威胁

title.zh: 哪些问题有加速：BQP 与平方加速的打平点
title.en: Which problems speed up: BQP and the quadratic crossover

desc.zh: 指数加速只在有特殊结构的问题上；平方加速要等问题大到慢速的量子门追上快速的经典计算，才有意义。
desc.en: Exponential speed-ups need special structure; a quadratic one pays off only once the problem is big enough for slow quantum gates to catch fast classical ones.

zh: 量子计算机能解决NP完全问题吗
量子计算机比普通电脑快吗
en: can quantum computers solve NP-complete problems

desc.zh: 每一步都有一点出错的概率，T1 和 T2 有限；门错误率 0.5% 时，6 个比特的格罗弗搜索就从 99.7% 掉到约 47%。
desc.en: Every step has a small chance of error and T1, T2 are finite; at 0.5% per gate a six-qubit Grover search drops from 99.7% to about 47%.

zh: 量子计算机为什么难造
en: why are quantum computers hard to build

title.zh: 量子纠错：重复码与表面码
title.en: Quantum error correction: repetition and surface codes

desc.zh: 不看数据只看奇偶校验就能找出错误；物理错误率低于阈值时，码距越大逻辑错误越少，代价是每个逻辑比特上千个物理比特。
desc.en: Parity checks find errors without looking at the data; below threshold a larger code distance means fewer logical errors, at a cost of about a thousand physical qubits per logical one.

title.zh: 2026 年的前沿：硬件、量子优势与资源估计
title.en: The 2026 frontier: hardware, advantage claims and resource estimates

desc.zh: Willow、Helios、中性原子阵列等的实测指标，量子优势的宣称与争议，破解 RSA 的资源估计，以及后量子密码的时间表，每条都注明日期和出处。
desc.en: Measured figures for Willow, Helios, neutral-atom arrays and others, contested advantage claims, resource estimates for breaking RSA and the post-quantum timetable, each dated and sourced.

en: when will quantum computers be useful

title.zh: 读量子新闻的五个问题
title.en: Five questions for reading quantum news

desc.zh: 物理还是逻辑比特、步数乘错误率、任务有没有用、经典算法试过没有、加速是哪一级；以及现在就该为后量子密码做什么。
desc.en: Physical or logical qubits, steps times error rate, whether the task is useful, whether the best classical method was tried, which kind of speed-up; and what to do about post-quantum cryptography now.
